Subject: SiteGrid private deployment inquiry

Hi Mina,

We're exploring a private Redwood deployment inside our VPC for inference serving (SiteGrid product). We want alignment on cluster footprint, node class sizing for mixed GPU and CPU workloads, and an approach to persistent block storage for model artifacts and KV caches. High-level constraints: 8 racks at our primary site, limited on-prem NVMe (4 per rack) and a separate SAN for archival.

Could you share a recommended starting cluster layout and any preflight inventory we should prepare? Our initial ask is a 6–8 week rollout window, with a pilot (2 racks) to validate latency SLAs.

Thanks,
Carlos

- NVMe model and endurance numbers, and details on SAN throughput/IOPS targets.
- Expected concurrent active sessions (QPS) for the pilot and projected production QPS.

What I'll do next: Marissa will draft a compact nodeclass/IO matrix and I will produce a short preflight checklist tailored to your SAN+NVMe mix. I'm attaching a blank inventory CSV to make the intake simpler.

If that aligns, can we get your inventory by EOD Friday? Also looping Marissa for the nodeclass matrix and Aditya for procurement questions.

Subject: Fwd: SiteGrid private deployment inquiry / nodeclass + storage matrix

Forwarding a compact matrix I put together based on similar SAN+NVMe topologies. Notes inline — key decisions we've made for comparable customers:

* Nodeclass breakdown (pilot):
  - control-plane: 3x m6-standard (CPU-only) across racks for HA
  - worker-gpu-large: 8x a6000-equivalent per rack (for model inference)
  - worker-gpu-small: 4x a10-equivalent per rack (lower concurrency, cost-sensitive)
  - worker-cpu-burst: 6x c5-like (batching, off-peak encoding)

* Storage binding recommendation:
  - Model artifacts: mount from SAN (NBD/ISCSI) with read-mostly lifecycle, nightly sync to SAN -> archival tier.
  - KV cache: local NVMe with LRU eviction, periodic snapshot to SAN for warm restart (reduces network dependency).
  - Logs/metrics: ephemeral journaling to local NVMe, aggregated to central Prometheus/ELK over 10Gb link.

* IO guardrails:
  - Throttle large checkpoint writes to off-peak windows; use async upload to SAN.
  - Reserve 20% spare NVMe capacity per node for eviction buffers.

I've attached the nodeclass matrix and a short preflight checklist PDF (redwood_preflight_checklist.pdf). We'll want to confirm your SAN multipath config and whether iSCSI or NVMe-oF is preferred — NVMe-oF gives lower latency but may require changes to your switch fabric.

Attachment: catalog-nodeclass-matrix.xlsx; redwood_preflight_checklist.pdf

-M
